_comment: 10 hand-labelled SOP-style text pairs for the dedup.py calibration test. duplicate=true means a human would standardize the pair into one shared step.

pairs.a: Record the registration in the activity log. You append an entry to the activity ledger with the alias set to the project alias.
pairs.b: Append compile event to the activity log with the tag kb-compile for the compiled alias.

pairs.a: Read the document metadata back via the connector to confirm it exists at the expected location with the expected title.
pairs.b: Read the file metadata back through the connector to confirm it exists at the expected location with the expected title.

pairs.a: Acquire the kb lock file before writing any KB page and release the lock after the write phase completes.
pairs.b: Acquire the kb lock file before writing KB pages, then release the lock after the write phase is complete.

pairs.a: Display a summary to the owner listing pages updated, entity counts and contradictions detected during the run.
pairs.b: Display the summary to the owner listing pages updated, entity counts, contradictions detected and the trust state.

pairs.a: Log the publish event to the activity ledger with the skill name recorded in the skills used field.
pairs.b: Write the setup event to the activity log and record the skill name in the skills used field.

pairs.a: Present the full draft and wait for explicit approval before any action that leaves the machine.
pairs.b: Compute the health token from the index frontmatter and render the matching colorblind safe symbol.

pairs.a: Resolve the destination Drive folder from the registered project sources before creating the document.
pairs.b: Resolve the portfolio data root from the environment variable and fall back to the default data folder.

pairs.a: Create the knowledge base directory and seed the eight page templates for the new project.
pairs.b: Create the workspace folder outside the data folder and register it as an artifact source on the entity.

pairs.a: Scan registered Gmail labels for new messages since the rolling floor of the previous compile.
pairs.b: Scan the calendar for recurring meetings to propose candidate project groupings to the owner.

pairs.a: Validate the compiled index frontmatter carries health and next action fields before reporting.
pairs.b: Delete the compile sentinel so the safety gate returns to blocking knowledge base writes again.
